   def compute_C5(h):
       npartial = np.sum(h)
       if abs(npartial - n_points/2) > 1e-2:  # Sum validity check
           return float('inf'), None
       corr_full = np.correlate(h, 1-h, mode='full')
       corr_full *= dx/dx  # Keep dx in evaluation
       c5 = np.max(corr_full)
       return c5, corr_full
